results.contract: Only the latest successful reload may commit documentData and emit RELOAD; stale or disposed reads must not overwrite state or surface stale errors.
source_evidence: src/audioPreviewEditor.ts:78-96 allocates a monotonically increasing request generation before readFile, suppresses superseded failures and checks generation/disposal before assigning documentData.
src/audioPreviewEditor.ts:109-115 invalidates pending reload generations before disposal.
src/audioPreviewEditor.ts:229-244 notifies only when reload returns true and catches latest read failure through the active-webview error path.
test_evidence: src/audioPreviewEditor.test.ts:360-379 asserts late older success cannot replace newer committed bytes and exactly one RELOAD is sent.
src/audioPreviewEditor.test.ts:381-429 covers failed latest reload preserving last committed bytes, later successful recovery, and stale failure suppression.
src/audioPreviewEditor.test.ts:431-473 covers both late success/failure after disposal and the boolean commit contract.
rejected_suspicions: A newer failure does not revive an older in-flight success: generation advances at request start and the old success remains invalid.
A superseded failure is caught inside reload and returns false; it is not left as an unhandled watcher rejection.
results.validation_limit: Focused unit tests and source tracing cover request completion order. This does not claim an end-to-end revision protocol for separately streamed DATA chunks.

results.contract: Export beside a source URI through its filesystem provider without converting virtual or remote resources to file URIs.
source_evidence: src/audioPreviewEditor.ts:375-387 derives the sibling with vscode.Uri.joinPath(document.uri, "..", filename) and passes that URI directly to workspace.fs.writeFile.
node_modules/@types/vscode/index.d.ts:1306-1326 documents joinPath preserving scheme, authority, query and fragment and normalizing parent path segments.
test_evidence: src/audioPreviewEditor.test.ts:475-506 verifies file and memfs resources retain scheme/authority and write /audio/export.wav with expected bytes.
The revised Uri mock models joinPath using the URI path and object spread, rather than reconstructing a file URI; original test assertions were not removed.
rejected_suspicions: Using the source file URI as the joinPath base does not make the export a child of the file: the explicit .. segment normalizes to its parent directory.
joinPath leaves non-path URI components intact according to the installed API declaration, matching provider identity requirements.
results.validation_limit: Provider identity and normalized sibling path verified via unit mocks plus local API contract; no live remote filesystem provider was exercised.

test_integrity.notes: Diff relative to baseline adds regression cases. Harness changes supply URI identity and writeFile/change-event support; existing assertions remain.
